background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: I choose New Generic Appearance from the create-appearance menu
a selected appearance named "Default Generic" is added to Document Appearances
a separate Appearance Editor opens for "Default Generic"
the editor shows a shaded preview and an editable appearance name
the Generic section shows Color, Image, Image Fade, Glossiness and Highlights
OK and Apply are disabled before edits
